subject.title: Embedded agent: auto-rotate (or persist a marker) on context-overflow give_up instead of wedging the session until manual /reset

question: Should exhausted embedded-agent context-overflow recovery be fixed first by accepting the durable `lastBlockedRun` marker in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102178, or should this issue wait for guarded one-shot auto-rotation and replay semantics?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally preserve the session mapping after failed overflow recovery, while the issue asks to change core recovery and durable state behavior for autonomous sessions.

options.title: Accept marker-first recovery
options.body: Proceed with the durable blocked marker after compatibility review, leaving automatic rotation and replay safety for a separate design path.

options.title: Require guarded rotation first
options.body: Keep the issue open for one-shot rotate-and-replay semantics with explicit side-effect, loop-cap, and recovery-surface proof.

options.title: Keep manual recovery
options.body: Retain the documented `/reset` or `/new` contract and limit follow-up to visibility, diagnostics, or docs improvements.

recommendation.title: Accept marker-first recovery
recommendation.body: Proceed with the durable blocked marker after compatibility review, leaving automatic rotation and replay safety for a separate design path.

likelyOwner.reason: This is primarily a durable session-state and recovery-policy decision, and steipete has the strongest recent ownership signal for those surfaces.
